record.name: Aircall
record.one_liner: Aircall is an AI-powered customer communications platform providing a REST API, webhooks, MCP support, and SDKs for third-party integrations.

auth.notes: Aircall supports both OAuth and Basic Auth depending on whether you are connecting as a Technology Partner or an Aircall customer.

access.notes: Aircall offers self-serve signup options on lower pricing tiers ('Get free access'), while full API access requires specific plans such as Professional or Enterprise.

api_surface.notes: Aircall provides a REST API, webhooks, MCP connectivity, and the Embed SDK.

mcp.notes: Aircall provides Model Context Protocol (MCP) support to connect tools and data to AI Virtual Agents.

buildability.reasoning: Full API access requires a Professional or Enterprise plan, but self-serve access and extensive API references are available.

evidence.claim: Mentions connecting tools and data to AI Virtual Agents through MCP, and using REST API and webhooks.
Documents REST API, OAuth, and Basic Auth options.
Shows Professional and Enterprise plans include 'Full API access'.
